scope: Portable publication of local exact linear-circuit methods; no claim generic ingredients are new.

upstream_reducer.credit: Andrey Perminov; sampler adapts his public API; optimization implementation obtained separately.

portable_implementation_changes: Root exact validator reused instead of private workspace imports.
Search wrappers build temporary binaries and refuse existing output directories.
Linked-pair generator uses arbitrary-precision Python integers with degree and connected-density selection.
Reachability cuts support count/overlap objectives and optional historical cut-growth heuristic.
Whole-tensor wire orientation includes a standalone signed transposition and parity model.
Historical private filesystem prefixes sanitized to experiment-relative provenance.
Public certificate metadata sanitized, hashes rebuilt; source and literal programs unchanged.
upstream_methods: CSE, vector covering, transposition, common exact DAG synthesis and local/plateau search are established ideas; witness and control claims are narrower.
publication_omissions: No upstream reducer source/binaries, private messages, credentials, historical bulk logs, or unrelated research checkout files.
